fact: A ministry speaker said Law No 2024-352 of 6 June 2024 on electronic communications contains measures to enable inclusive access for persons with disabilities, though implementation has been slow.
CIPESA says the Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization is reviewing its digital transition policy with a focus on prioritising persons with disabilities.

On 26 June 2025 the Ministry of Employment and Social Protection formally received, under a 13 May 2025 convention with the MTN Foundation, a job-matching website for job-seekers with disabilities, multimedia rooms at the Ivorian School for the Deaf and Felix Houphouet-Boigny University, and a YouTube channel for ECIS pupils.
